nodes.name: Dodo Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Receives Dodo Payments webhook events via Standard Webhooks spec.
Register this URL in: Dodo Dashboard → Developer → Webhooks → Add endpoint
URL: https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/dodo-webhook

Dodo will POST events with headers: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature

nodes.name: Normalize Dodo Payload
nodes.notes:
Extracts event metadata and passes raw body + signature headers forward.
The backend /webhooks/dodo endpoint handles normalization and DB insert.
Relevant events: payment.succeeded, payment.failed, payment.refunded, payment.cancelled

nodes.name: POST /webhooks/dodo
nodes.notes:
Forwards the raw Dodo event + Standard Webhooks headers to the backend.
The backend verifies the signature, normalizes the payload, and upserts
into dodo_payments (onConflict: payment_id).

For local dev replace localhost:4000 with your tunnel URL (ngrok, cloudflared, etc.)

nodes.name: Was Payment Stored?
nodes.notes:
Only trigger reconciliation if the backend successfully stored the payment.
If the event type was ignored (e.g. payment.processing), skip reconciliation.

nodes.name: POST /reconcile/run
nodes.notes:
Triggers a full deterministic reconciliation run after each webhook.
Timeout is 60s — reconciliation against large datasets may take a few seconds.
The run result (MATCHED/MISMATCHED/MISSING/DUPLICATE counts) will appear
in the dashboard at http://localhost:5173/

nodes.name: Return 200 to Dodo
nodes.notes:
Must respond 200 within 5 seconds or Dodo will mark the delivery as failed and retry.
This node fires immediately — reconciliation runs asynchronously after.
